issue_title: PyJWT.decode_complete() method changing provided options object
prompt_transformation: Chinese symptom-only paraphrase of the issue title, expected behavior, and actual behavior; retain API and options keys; omit the issue's source filename, source excerpt, solution suggestion, PR, and later comments.
selection_rule: Small Python repository; an original bug issue explicitly linked to a merged single-commit repair; narrow production diff and a self-contained mutation reproduction. Selected before any CodeLens localization run.

evaluation_protocol.ranking: Original candidate order, deduplicate exact repository-relative paths without reranking
evaluation_protocol.ground_truth: Production Python source files modified by this fix; test changes are recorded separately
evaluation_protocol.top_k_rule: any(candidate_path in ground_truth for candidate_path in candidates[:k])
evaluation_protocol.tie_handling: Use the agent's actual returned order, no manual tie-breaking
evaluation_protocol.no_adaptation: Do not change agent code, weights, query text, or budgets after observing the result
evaluation_protocol.snapshot_isolation: Agent sees only a clean git-archive export of before_commit; history, fixed tree, experiment files and fix diff stay outside its repository root
